tldr: This is not one story: the items share the phrase "large language models" and are mostly arXiv papers from Oct 21 onward. Two real threads sit inside it: the Mistral Large 4 launch on Oct 29, and a run of papers on how LLMs and agents handle memory, retrieval, and knowledge updates.
whats_new: The Nov 9 additions are two arXiv papers, a personality-influence benchmark and an LLM-as-AutoML-searcher, so no new event has landed since Mistral Large 4 got day-0 vLLM and Hugging Face support on Oct 29.
why_it_matters: The only deployable change here is Mistral Large 4 on vLLM; the memory and retrieval papers are research signal for agent context design, not shipped tooling.

beats.headline: Unrelated LLM papers share a phrase, not an event
beats.summary: Oct 21–28 arXiv work spans materials extraction, steering, continual learning, translated benchmarks, and a long-horizon web-search eval.

beats.headline: Mistral Large 4 ships with day-0 vLLM and Hugging Face support
beats.summary: vLLM lists sparse MLA, cross-layer KV sharing, speculative decoding, and P/D disaggregation on NVIDIA Blackwell.

beats.headline: Memory, retrieval, and knowledge updates become the densest sub-thread
beats.summary: Papers and practitioner pieces Oct 29–Nov 6 on RAG-to-parametric distillation, memory graphs, context engines, and knowledge editing.

beats.headline: Scattered research continues, led by Anthropic's provable-inference update
beats.summary: Text-to-SQL survey, extreme-sparsity pruning, zkSNARK provable inference, federated aggregation, personality benchmarking, and AutoML search.

open_questions: Do independent benchmarks of Mistral Large 4 on vLLM confirm its long-context and throughput claims?
Does any provider publish Mistral Large 4 API pricing that confirms or overturns the reported price gap with DeepSeek and Cohere?
Does Anthropic ship provable inference (zkSNARK) as a product feature or customer-verifiable API option?
Does any agent framework adopt a separate context/memory/knowledge layer like the one InfoQ and the harness paper describe?
take_for_builders: If you serve open weights, test Mistral Large 4 on a current vLLM build before adopting it; treat the memory and retrieval papers as design input for your context layer, not drop-in components.
